note: Reported cohorts demonstrate that cutaneous autoinflammatory manifestations such as chilblains occur in only a small fraction (e.g., 2/24, or ~8.3%) of PSMD12-related STISS patients.

evidence.text: In a cohort of 24 additional unrelated patients with Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome due to PSMD12 variants/deletions, only 2 individuals exhibited chilblains resembling signs seen in interferonopathies.

source.title: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome: expanding the clinical and molecular phenotype
source.quote: We report 24 additional unrelated patients with STISS with various truncating single nucleotide variants or copy-number variant deletions involving PSMD12. ... Of note, 2 patients also showed chilblains resembling signs observed in interferonopathy.
